calls.statement:
SELECT s.store_id = 900 AS is_web, s.store_id = 999 AS is_train, p.category = 'ZZ Test' AS is_test, f.vat_rate, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_diff, sum(round(f.net_amount*f.vat_rate,2)) AS vat_calc, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.*, p.vat_class, p.category, s.store_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test')
SELECT 'dup_receipt_line' AS chk, count(*) - count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS v FROM l
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id', count(*) - count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM l
UNION ALL SELECT 'null_vat_or_gross', count(*) FROM l WHERE vat_rate IS NULL OR gross_amount IS NULL OR net_amount IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'vat_mismatch_class_' || vat_class || '_' || CAST(vat_rate AS VARCHAR), count(*) FROM l GROUP BY vat_class, vat_rate
UNION ALL SELECT 'gross_ne_net_x_rate', count(*) FROM l WHERE abs(gross_amount - round(net_amount*(1+vat_rate),2)) > 0.02
UNION ALL SELECT 'chan_' || coalesce(channel_code,'null'), count(*) FROM l GROUP BY channel_code
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_qty_or_amt', count(*) FROM l WHERE quantity <= 0 OR net_amount < 0
UNION ALL SELECT 'staff_lines', count(*) FROM l WHERE staff_purchase_flag
UNION ALL SELECT 'multi_loaded', count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) FROM l

calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount, f.receipt_id, f.sale_ts_utc FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'),
mine AS (SELECT sale_date, store_id, sum(net_amount) AS net, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS rc FROM l GROUP BY ALL),
ctl AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales_before_returns AS net, receipts AS rc FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND store_id < 900 AND store_id <> 999)
SELECT count(*) AS store_days, sum(CASE WHEN m.sale_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS only_ctl, sum(CASE WHEN c.business_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS only_mine,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(coalesce(m.net,0)-coalesce(c.net,0))>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS net_diff_days, sum(coalesce(m.net,0)) AS my_net, sum(coalesce(c.net,0)) AS ctl_net, sum(coalesce(m.rc,0)) AS my_rc, sum(coalesce(c.rc,0)) AS ctl_rc
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.business_date=m.sale_date AND c.store_id=m.store_id

SELECT r.vat_rate, count(*) AS n, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net, sum(r.refund_gross - r.refund_net) AS refund_vat
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.vat_rate, round(sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount),2) AS vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY f.vat_rate ORDER BY f.vat_rate
